source: This classification also explains why memory capacity and bandwidth pressure shift with workload. Training stores more state. Long-context inference grows KV state. Small-batch decode may repeatedly stream weights with limited arithmetic reuse. One hierarchy serves all of them, but the traffic pattern is different.
zh: 这种分类还解释了为什么内存容量和带宽压力会随着工作负载而变化。培训商店更多状态。长上下文推理增加了 KV 状态。小批量解码可能会以有限的算术重用来重复流式传输权重。一个层次结构为所有这些服务提供服务，但流量模式不同。
